definitions.explanation: Relating to or occurring in ordinary daily life. Describes things that are part of one's regular, unremarkable routine.

examples.japanese: {日常的|にちじょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I exercise on a daily basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日常的|にちじょうてき}なことだ。
examples.english: Earthquakes are an everyday occurrence in this area.

examples.japanese: {日常的|にちじょうてき}な⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}びたい→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I want to learn expressions used in everyday conversation.

notes:
USAGE:
The adverb form {日常的|にちじょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is very common. Contrasts with {非日常的|ひにちじょうてき} (extraordinary, out of the ordinary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use on a daily basis)
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}な⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧ (everyday scene)
- {日常的|にちじょうてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (daily life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: everyday, daily life — the noun form
- ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧: usually, normally — more casual, adverbial
